name: escarpment
description: An escarpment dressed by the cliffs generator (domain/rocks, docs/subsystems/rocks.md 'The cliffs generator'): an authored ridge 120 m high whose two steep flanks are found from the ground's heights, their feet traced into lines and stood with sandstone faces — ledges, undercut beds, gullies, a talus skirt and fallen blocks — and granite boulders at their feet. It needs no sample asset, but its heightfield is written first by engine-content terrain-synth (README.md).
